## Current Twelve-Child Bounds Tree Profile Hypothesis

A fresh profile of the restored 12-child accepted source will establish the current process-local throughput, p95, and insertion self-time reference needed to distinguish experiment 113's structural improvement from stale experiment-102 benchmark variance.

**Attempt Count:** 1.

### Scope Lock

Measurement only. Run the existing exclusive Test Suite wide DataTable profile at both DPRs and record current bounds-tree counters and timing. Product code, tests, dependencies, configuration, and fixtures are forbidden.

reportMarkdown:
# Experiment 114 Report

The restored 12-child BoundsTree checkpoint passed the exclusive Test Suite headed WASM/WebGPU benchmark at DPR 1 and DPR 2. Both runs reached the exact final offset with zero terminal error.

At DPR 1, median acknowledged throughput was 29.06310573869915 steps/s, paced p95 catch-up latency was 27.759033203125 ms, and sampled BoundsTree insertion self-time was 155.246 ms. At DPR 2, the corresponding measurements were 29.347909265949358 steps/s, 27.533447265625 ms, and 144.38899999999998 ms.

The deterministic structural counters matched the accepted 12-child topology at both DPRs: 504 insertions, 7 fast leaf hits, 495 slow searches, 4,440 search-node visits, 14,351 child evaluations, and 576 retained nodes.

The fresh throughput is substantially above experiment 102's older process-local sample, confirming that experiment 113 cannot be decided fairly against that stale reference. These measurements are the sole paired baseline for a separately declared 16-child retest.
decisionMarkdown:
# Decision

Accept the measurement experiment. No product source changed. Use this exact two-DPR result as the only performance reference for the next independently declared 16-child BoundsTree experiment.
